bibl.title: PL III/1032 A: testo patristico?
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, PL III/1032 A: testo patristico?
bibl.note: Provenance unknown, about IVp. Fragment of a code; the content, in prose, could be of a sacred type, even if not entirely clear: the authors, who have more lexical links with the text, are all patristic writers, which can be placed among IVp and Vp: Athanasius, Didymus the Blind, John Chrysostom.
